headline: "Bad From the Intent": Opposition Attacks Lee Government's Economic Policies, Covering Real Estate, Stocks and Pensions
summary: The People Power Party has targeted the Lee Jae-myung government's economic policies, focusing on real estate and the stock market. It reactivated its real estate special committee and called for the dismissal of a presidential policy chief.
why: Government economic policy on housing and equity markets influences investor expectations for South Korean assets.
